name: google-analytics-mcp
description: Self-hosted remote MCP server for Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console, running on Cloudflare Workers.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID from Google Cloud. Create a Web application client at https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients and add the redirect URI shown on this Worker's home page.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret for that same Google OAuth client.

OAUTH_KV.description: KV namespace for OAuth grants. Google refresh tokens are stored encrypted inside it by workers-oauth-provider. A new namespace is created during deploy.

HOSTED_DOMAIN.description: Optional. A Google Workspace domain (example.com) to restrict sign-in. Leave blank to allow any Google account.

MCP_RESOURCE.description: Optional. Full MCP URL, such as https://google-analytics-mcp.<account>.workers.dev/mcp. Leave blank to use the host of each request.
